title: Shifted cohomology and absorption identifications on fixed pairs
statement:
Let $\mathcal T$ be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] with a bounded t-structure $t$ [def-weil-t-structure], its canonical truncations and heart-valued cohomology [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles]. Let $P:\mathcal T\to\mathcal T$ be an exact autoequivalence such that $P$ and its inverse preserve both halves in every integer degree, with coherent shift comparison $s_{K,r}:P(K[r])\simeq(PK)[r]$. In the fixed-pair category [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category] objects are $(K,\theta_K:PK\simeq K)$ and arrows satisfy $u\theta_K=\theta_LP(u)$. Write $c^-_{m,K}:P\tau^{\le m}K\simeq\tau^{\le m}PK$ and $c^+_{m,K}:P\tau^{\ge m}K\simeq\tau^{\ge m}PK$ for the canonical comparisons normalized by the truncation maps [lem-pod-texact-truncation-comparison], and equip each truncation with $\tau(\theta_K)c_{m,K}$, the canonical lifts of [lem-a1-fixed-pair-truncation-orthogonality].

For every $r\in\mathbf Z$, the formulas $(K,\theta_K)[r]=(K[r],\theta_K[r]s_{K,r})$ and $u\mapsto u[r]$ define a functor on fixed pairs. For $i\in\mathbf Z$ put $Z_K=\tau^{\ge i}\tau^{\le i}K$ and $H^iK=Z_K[i]$. This composite of the lifted truncations and shift is a functor into fixed pairs whose underlying objects lie in the heart. Its structure is $H^i(\theta_K)e_{i,K}$, where
$$e_{i,K}=\bigl(\tau^{\ge i}(c^-_{i,K})c^+_{i,\tau^{\le i}K}\bigr)[i]s_{Z_K,i}:P(H^iK)\simeq H^i(PK).$$
It maps every fixed-pair arrow to $H^i(u)$; forgetting recovers exactly the underlying cohomology functor.

For every $m\in\mathbf Z$ the canonical absorption isomorphisms
$$\tau^{\le m-1}\tau^{\le m}K\simeq\tau^{\le m-1}K,\qquad \tau^{\ge m+1}\tau^{\ge m}K\simeq\tau^{\ge m+1}K$$
are isomorphisms of fixed pairs, with the iterated lifted structures. The first is normalized by its composite to $K$ and the second by its composite from $K$. The canonical identifications
$$\tau^{\ge m}\tau^{\le m}K\simeq H^m(K)[-m],\qquad \tau^{\le m}\tau^{\ge m}K\simeq H^m(K)[-m]$$
are also isomorphisms of fixed pairs with the indicated shifted cohomology structure, including the canonical interchange of the two truncations in the second identification. These are natural isomorphisms of objects of $\mathcal T$ equipped with structures, not merely per-degree identifications. No triangulated structure on the fixed-pair category is assumed.

Their normalization equations and naturality of the truncation counit and unit give fixed-pair natural transformations from upper truncation to the identity and from the identity to lower truncation. proof.text: Mathlib instances show that truncGELE i i K lies in both t-structure halves at i: truncGE preserves upper bounds and supplies the lower bound. The isLE_shift and isGE_shift lemmas with shift i and output degree zero put its shift in the heart. No separate interchange argument is needed for this clause.

Whisker the equivariant upper counit at m by fixedPairTruncLE (m-1). Its underlying components are truncLE (m-1) of the counit at m. Mathlib isIso_truncLE_map_truncLEι_app proves these invertible because m-1 ≤ m. Algebra.iso_of_iso and ObjectProperty.isIso_hom_iff reflect this to fixed pairs; NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app then gives a natural isomorphism. Naturality of the counit at m-1 is exactly the required composite-to-K normalization.

proof.text: Dually whisker the equivariant lower unit at m by fixedPairTruncGE (m+1). Mathlib isIso_truncGE_map_truncGEπ_app proves its underlying components invertible because m ≤ m+1. Reflect the isomorphism to fixed pairs and invert the natural isomorphism. Naturality of the unit at m+1 rewrites the composite-from-K normalization as the hom-inverse identity.

proof.text: Lift the actual Mathlib adjunction maps to the canonical fixed-pair truncations. For liftTruncLE, postcompose the equivariance equation with the counit; the normalized upper comparison, liftTruncLE_ι and t-exactness of P prove it by to_truncLE_obj_ext. For descTruncGE, first precompose with the inverse lower comparison and then with the unit; its normalization, π_descTruncGE and from_truncGE_obj_ext prove equivariance. Apply descTruncGE then liftTruncLE to the composite upper counit followed by lower unit. The two factorization equations give the pentagon. The uniqueness assertion of lem-pod-truncation-interchange-pentagon identifies this map with the hom of the canonical truncGELEIsoLEGE. Transfer equivariance to that isomorphism, construct its algebra and full-subcategory isomorphisms, and use naturality of the underlying canonical interchange.

source.place: 1.3.5, defining pentagon and its two adjunction factorizations; the factorizations lifted to fixed pairs

proof.text: Functor.map_shiftFunctorCompIsoId_hom_app is the zero-and-addition coherence calculation for P. Together with map_comp and naturality of shift cancellation it proves equivariance of Z[m][-m] → Z. Algebra.isoMk and ObjectProperty.isoMk lift the canonical cancellation to a natural isomorphism of fixed pairs. Invert it and whisker on the left by the composite lifted truncations to obtain the first cohomology identification. Compose with the inverse lifted interchange for the second. Computing the components gives exactly the two displayed underlying maps, with the identity component of the right unitor removed by id_comp.
